notes:
# Orvio 0.10

**Phone**
- New look throughout, in deeper blacks with a warm gold accent.
- Home: a featured banner with the newest titles, Recently watched (live channels and where you stopped), favourite channels and poster rows.
- Movies and Series: search with a category button, quick filters (All, Favorites, newest, A–Z), a cleaner Filter & sort sheet and IMDb / Rotten Tomatoes scores on the posters.
- Live TV: edge-to-edge player with LIVE badge and controls, channel name with cast, favourite and info buttons, now and next with a progress bar, provider categories as quick filters and a clearer channel list.
- Playlist settings: one overview with status, coloured library counts and the last update.
- No white flash at start-up; the update banner floats above the navigation and release notes are shorter.

**TV**
- Same new colours.

First installation is manual. Existing installations download this update over the air; Android still asks to install it.

Audio decoder binaries are unchanged from 0.05; corresponding sources and licenses are attached.
